parameters.query: INSERT INTO policies (policy_id, partner, customer_email, product, start_date, premium_eur) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::date, $6::numeric) ON CONFLICT (policy_id) DO UPDATE SET customer_email = EXCLUDED.customer_email, product = EXCLUDED.product, start_date = EXCLUDED.start_date, premium_eur = EXCLUDED.premium_eur, loaded_at = now();
INSERT INTO rejected_rows (run_id, partner, raw_row, reason) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4);
INSERT INTO load_runs (run_id, rows_read, rows_loaded, rows_rejected) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4);
